result.summary: The environment features a wide urban roadway with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and well-maintained sidewalks. However, the lack of a pedestrian refuge, signalization, or curb extensions increases exposure and limits visibility due to parked cars near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb lines immediately adjacent to the zebra crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Wide Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks any signalization or stop control, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic and parking in a single unprotected movement.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extending the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian exposure distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Installing a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for an extended period due to the width of the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corners appear wide, which can encourage vehicles to make turns at higher speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and lane markings are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected Bike Infrastructure
hazards.description: The presence of sharrows indicates cyclists must share the travel lane with motor vehicles, creating potential conflict points.
